rounds.name: Worker-Ives
rounds.text:
Since we have no history with Worker‑Ives, we can’t trust they’ll do the job properly; withholding pay gives a higher baseline payoff even if they cut corners (5 vs 3) and still yields a positive result if they slack (1 vs 0). Thus the safer choice is to withhold.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD
